fusions.name: Ripe Picking
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Plucks it for 9 damage, heals you for 35% of the damage dealt and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Laden Bough
fusions.desc: Shakes down 5 heavy fruit in a spread, each dealing 6 damage. Your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Compost Banquet
fusions.desc: Needs at least 1 body within 9 tiles. Your roots drain every body in reach, up to 5, and each restores 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Gleaner's Appetite
fusions.desc: Each kill restores 4 health. When you kill an enemy, you also receive 40% more healing for 8 seconds, once every 10 seconds.
